name: sci-research
description: Five specialised intelligence workflows plus weekly CRD VI transposition and regulatory-news tracking, with project-scoped runtime setup.

interface.shortDescription: News, regulatory, reputation, and opportunity intelligence
interface.longDescription: Specialised workflows: daily-news-intelligence for dated single-country reporting, monthly-news-intelligence for offline monthly synthesis from existing daily reports, daily-briefing for a multi-country branded Word document, reputation-track for company and executive risk alerts, crd-vi-transposition for weekly snapshot-and-delta monitoring plus exact-week regulatory news and market commentary, and china-outbound-opportunity-briefing for UK economic signals, Chinese expansion into Europe, cross-border M&A, investment footprints, and Companies House entity changes. The CRD VI workflow isolates media commentary from official country-status evidence. A setup skill installs the namespaced TOML custom agents into the active project.
defaultPrompt: Create a sourced daily or monthly country-news report
Track weekly CRD VI transposition changes and regulatory news across all EU countries
Monitor company risk or UK-Europe commercial opportunities
